binary from 1.24.0 onward. 1.23.0 is the last release that has one.
@huggingface/transformers depends on an EXACT version above that (4.2.0
pins onnxruntime-node@1.24.3), so npm installs it NESTED under
dependency is simply ignored. Only an override reaches it.
Without this line, backend/src/memory/embed.ts dies at model load with
— a message that reads like a broken install and names nothing that would
lead you here. Verified by installing both versions and importing them on
backend/package.json pins the same exact version as a direct dependency.

//devDependencies: The three istanbul packages are `scripts/merge-coverage.mjs`'s. The suite
runs as two vitest processes, vitest 2.1 has no --merge-reports, and its
v8 provider keeps per-worker coverage in an in-process Map — so the two
coverage-final.json files have to be merged by hand into the one report
`scripts/check-coverage.mjs` reads. They arrive anyway as transitive
dependencies of @vitest/coverage-v8; declared here because a script that
imports a package should say so, and hoisting is not a contract.
